reason_plain: An opioid plus a benzodiazepine. Beers advises avoiding this combination because of the risk of overdose, heavy sedation and breathing problems.
source: 2023 American Geriatrics Society Beers Criteria Update Expert Panel. American Geriatrics Society 2023 updated AGS Beers Criteria for potentially inappropriate medication use in older adults. reason_plain: An opioid plus gabapentin or pregabalin. Beers advises avoiding this combination (with some exceptions) because of the risk of severe sedation and breathing problems.
recommendation: Exceptions: when switching from an opioid to gabapentin or pregabalin, or using them to lower the opioid dose.

reason_plain: More than one strongly anticholinergic medicine. Together they raise the risk of memory decline, delirium and falls.
recommendation: Avoid; keep the number of anticholinergic drugs (Beers Table 7) as low as possible.
